info.name: Audio Archive
info.summary: Audio player for recordings stored in Nextcloud, installable and usable offline
info.description:
Plays audio recordings from a folder in Nextcloud.
* Browses the real folder structure, however deeply nested * Keeps playing when the screen is off, with lock screen controls * Can be installed on the home screen and used offline * Optional public access with a shared password, for listeners without an account
info.author: Gemeinde
